| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Width** `width` | 10 | 1 to 40 px | How far from the pointer the tool looks for an edge. |
| **Contrast** `contrast` | 10 | 1 to 100 % | The weakest edge the tool follows, in percent of the strongest edge in the image. |
| **Anchor spacing** `spacing` | 40 | 5 to 200 px | The path length after which the tool fixes an anchor point by itself. |
| **Feather** `feather` | 0 | 0 to 250 px | Softens the edge of the new selection. |
| **Anti-alias** `antiAlias` | on | On or off | Gives edge pixels a value for the part of them that the shape covers. |
